subject: Hook: On entry/exit of child document?

messages.author: 3ef7a01c7d912ca2
messages.subject: Hook: On entry/exit of child document?
parts:
My documents make heavy use of child documents, so my main document only looks like this:

```{r child="CapsuleRInit.Rmd"}
```
```
```{r child="CapsuleEmptying.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
```
```{r child="CapsulePosition.Rmd", eval=TRUE}
```

Besides a few globals in RInit, I want to enforce that each child document cleans up all the mess it has created with the following code:

Top of child document
```{r}
BeforeObjects = ls()

Do other work.......
```

End of child document
```{r}
rm(list=setdiff(ls(), BeforeObjects))
```

I was thinking of automating this by implementing something like a "OnChildEntry" and "OnChildExit" hook. Any hint how to get this to work?

Dieter
